latest_audits.result: The paper clearly specifies the candidate-validation/release/task-boundary/rollback architecture and reports strong three-seed YC-Bench gains, but the linked official repository currently contains only a README saying source code and documentation will be released soon. Concrete gate thresholds, Trig configuration and Canary degradation thresholds are not recoverable from public implementation/config because none is released. Published OLE token totals explicitly exclude candidate-generation calls whose usage was not retained, so 64.52M/59.63M are observable lower bounds rather than complete all-in evolution costs. The located daiwk/auto-research implementation is a declared one-seed deterministic L1 mini-suite whose agent returns supplied answer/plan and increments diagnostic counters; it does not reproduce YC-Bench, actual candidate generation, gate thresholds, task-boundary activation or rollback. No protocol-matched independent YC-Bench rerun was located.
